 Appearance:
 Shri Amitabh Gupta - Advocate For The Applicant.
 Shri D. K. Paroha - Government Advocate For The
 Respondent-State.

Shri Abhishek Dilraj - Advocate For The Objector.
 Order

This is the third bail application filed under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.262/2022, registered at Police Station Ratibarh, District Bhopal (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Sections 406, 417, 468,
471, 498-A, 506, 420, 467, 201 of the IPC.

First bail application has been dismissed as withdrawn,
whereas second application has been dismissed on merit vide order dated 09/10/2023 passed in M.Cr.C.No.41937/2023.

2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is in jail since 04/07/2022 i.e.
for more than two years.
He is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
It is submitted that as per the prosecution story the applicant has induced major woman and had married her.
He has deceived her and has taken away a huge amount of money from her.
It is submitted that investigated is completed and charge-sheet has been filed.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.

Learned Government Advocate appearing for the respondent/State as well as objector opposed the bail application and submitted that the applicant is habitual offender and in similar way he has deceived many other women.
The applicant is having criminal antecedents.
He is resident of Gujrat and he may not be available for trial, if he is released on bail.

It is further submitted that his earlier Dhun Premal Thakkar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/15003434/

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. The applicant is in jail for more than two years, investigation is complete and trial is still in progress.

Considering the nature of allegations made against the applicant and period of custody,
without commenting on the merits of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed with the following conditions :-
(i) The applicant shall mark his presence before police station Ratibarh, District Bhopal every month.
(ii) Applicant, if found involved in any other offence in future, then bail granted by this Court today shall stand cancelled and applicant be arrested in this crime number.
(iii) He will regularly attend the trial and will not seek unnecessary adjournments..

6. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount, out of which one should be local to the satisfaction of the trial court for his regular appearance before Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard.
Certified copy as per rules.
